launch.checks_and_smoke: supervisor runs 4 contracts then 20 updates before main trial

study_protocol.comparison_rule: terminal8192 BOTH rear NMSE at least5% lower than MLP12; FL/FR/C no more than5% higher; dry relative null RMS<=1e-5
study_protocol.fixed_crop_gate: BOTH rear NMSE<=.10 and dry relative null RMS<=1e-5
study_protocol.scope: one fixed .699s TRAIN crop and one seed; no generalization/device/car claim

run_protocol.initialization: fresh same-seed weights; all anchor weights identical; new causal encoded-history branch
run_protocol.loss: fixed TRAIN channel-power-normalized complex MSE + .05 magnitude MAE

specification.excludes: FFT/WOLA, features, projection, complex application, normalization, nonlinearities and LFE DSP

encoded_history.input: pooled normalized encoder BEFORE temporal GRU
encoded_history.temporal_state: unchanged GRU state plus explicit encoded cache

run_protocol.intervention: add depthwise temporal kernel4 and pointwise residual on current and three past pooled encoded frames BEFORE unchanged band GRU; same MLP12/global GRU/crop/loss/optimizer
run_protocol.pass_rule: both rear channel NMSE<=.10 and dry PCM relative null RMS<=1e-5 on this exact scored crop
run_protocol.scope: same-crop memorization only; not generalization, source safety or product qualification

scope: one fixed TRAIN crop and seed; matched8192 screen, no generalization/device/car qualification

loss_weight_diagnostic.source: existing MLP12 anchor protocol and terminal target_power; unchanged train_scene_joint_nas.loss

loss_gradient_audit.balanced_definition: per-crop TRAIN power-normalized complex MSE + .05 magnitude MAE; hypothetical objective only
loss_gradient_audit.slope_interpretation: negative local directional derivative means NMSE decreases for infinitesimal plain gradient descent; not AdamW or a training outcome

monitor_history_location: report.monitor_history; full anchor metrics in linked anchor_evidence
